decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec presents duplicate handling as a warning ('12 functional requirements covering ... duplicate handling'; R2 maker confirms the prior behavior: 'Duplicate save now opens the existing bookmark for editing instead of just warning'). R1 client: 'Saving the same address should take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it, rather than merely warning me.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Presented behavior (warn) contradicts REF-BM-06 (guide to edit existing). Client negates the warning and supplies the reference-conforming edit-existing behavior -> corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker only auto-derives a title ('auto-derive a title when none given'). R1 client: 'I also expect the app to collect the page title, description, site icon, and preview image when available, while letting me edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. R1 spec fulfills only part of REF-BM-02 (title); client requests the missing description/favicon/preview collection plus editable title/description (REF-BM-03) -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker list story is generic ('Browse ... list bookmarks'). R1 client: 'The list should emphasize the title, description, tags, and site icon for easy reading.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Readability-first list exposing title/description/tags/favicon (REF-BM-07) absent from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker organizes with tags but offers no autocomplete. R1 client: 'Suggestions from existing tags while entering tags.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-10 tag autocomplete missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker offers 'search by keyword' only. R1 client: 'Search across titles, descriptions, notes, addresses, and tags, without caring about capitalization.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. R1 keyword search under-fulfills REF-BM-12 (full-text over title/description/note/url) and omits REF-BM-13 (case-insensitive); client extends to full scope -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker has no advanced query syntax. R1 client: 'Exact phrases, `#tag` searches, and combinations such as AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-14 (#tag), REF-BM-15 (boolean/parentheses), REF-BM-16 (quoted phrase) all missing; client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no read state. R1 client: 'Read-later/read status and a separate unread view.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-17 (mark unread), REF-BM-18 (unread view), REF-BM-19 (mark read) missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no bulk actions. R1 client: 'Selecting several bookmarks—or everything matching the current search or filter—for actions such as tagging, read status, archiving, and deletion.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-20 (multi-select bulk) and REF-BM-21 (apply to whole matching filter) missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no sort control. R1 client: 'Sorting the bookmark list.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-22 sorting missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no notes. R1 client: 'Descriptions and notes, including formatted notes.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-23 markdown/formatted note missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no page preservation. R1 client: 'Preserving a local copy of a page, downloading the file itself for PDFs, plus an option to preserve it through the Internet Archive.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-24 (local snapshot + PDF rule) and REF-BM-25 (Internet Archive) missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no archiving. R1 client: 'Archiving as a reversible action, with archived items excluded from normal browsing and search.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-26 (archive hides), REF-BM-27 (reversible vs delete), REF-BM-28 (separate archive view implied) missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no saved filters. R1 client: 'Saving reusable combinations of searches and included or excluded tags.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-29 bundle/saved view missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker excludes import ('no ... browser-extension import'). R1 client: 'Importing and exporting standard browser bookmark files while retaining titles, tags, and dates.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-30 (Netscape import) and REF-BM-31 (export) missing; client extends -> extend. (Browser-extension import, infra I04, remains excluded; client requests standard-file import which is in-scope.)

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec has no settings. R1 client: 'Display preferences such as default sorting, number of items shown, and text size.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. REF-BM-32 display preferences missing; client extends -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker revision 2 makes only title/description editable ('title/description editable'). R2 client: 'I need to be able to edit the bookmark's address as well as its title, description, tags, and note.' R3 maker: 'US1 now covers editing title, description, and address.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate (rev 2). Editing url (REF-BM-04) absent from the editable-field set; client supplies the missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker offers tag filtering only via `#tag` search. R2 client: 'Selecting a visible tag on a bookmark should directly filter the list ...; requiring me to type a `#tag` search is not enough.' R3 maker adds FR-014a click-to-filter.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate (rev 2). The #tag-typing mechanism under-fulfills REF-BM-11 (select a specific tag to filter); client replaces it with the reference-conforming direct selection -> correct.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker specifies AND/OR/NOT with parentheses but not the quoting-to-literal rule. R2 client: 'Please state that words such as AND, OR, and NOT can still be searched as ordinary words when quoted.' R3 maker: FR-018 'AND/OR/NOT inside quotes are ordinary search text.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate (rev 2). The REF-BM-15 sub-rule ('operators themselves must be quoted to be treated as literal') was missing; client requests it -> extend. Distinct from the R1 operator extension, at a later refinement stage.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker describes preservation vaguely ('local copy, PDF file download'). R2 client: 'The locally preserved web page should be a self-contained HTML file. A PDF should still be stored as the PDF itself.' R3 maker: FR-031 'single self-contained HTML file with embedded assets; PDFs still stored as the PDF itself.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate (rev 2). Client supplies the reference-conforming single-file HTML form and reaffirms the PDF rule of REF-BM-24 -> correct. Distinct from the R1 preservation extension.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker plan carries bulk 'select all matching' but scoped narrowly (later analysis I1/U2 notes GET accepts only include quick-filter). R4 client: '"select all matching" must use the complete view I am currently looking at—not just the search words or one tag. That includes all included and excluded tags, the unread or archive view, and any saved view ... every page ... show the correct affected count.'
decisions.note: Plan-review gate. REF-BM-21 edge case limits bulk scope to the current filter/perspective; the plan under-scoped it, client corrects to the complete view across all pages -> correct. Same requirement as R1 bulk decision, distinct plan-stage presentation.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker analysis flags I1 (saved-view excluded tags not reachable in browse) and U2 (spec text thinner than design). R6 client: 'Strengthen the bulk-action requirement to name the complete current view ...' and 'Ensure a bulk action from a saved view uses that exact saved view—or its complete filters—so the affected count and the changed items exactly match what I am viewing.' R7 maker adds FR-025a and aligns browse+bulk resolver, closing I1.
decisions.note: Implementation-review/spec gate. Client corrects the saved-view bulk mismatch (REF-BM-29 filters feeding REF-BM-21 bulk) and pushes the guarantee into the spec source-of-truth -> correct. The R6 large-collection performance ask and the single-shared-collection/session guarantee are orthogonal to reference functional items and excluded.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Save a bookmark (P1) — add a link'. Retained unchanged through approval (R3 client: 'I approve the specification').
decisions.note: Baseline conforming decision matching REF-BM-01 (save by url); client did not contest -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Edit & delete — correct or remove bookmarks, with delete confirmation.' Not contested by client.
decisions.note: Baseline conforming decision matching REF-BM-05 (delete); delete-confirmation is an orthogonal UX addition -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse ... reopen ... open the original page.' Not contested by client.
decisions.note: Baseline conforming decision matching REF-BM-08 (selecting an item navigates to the original url) -> not_divergent.
